profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Amplify
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Amplify and graduate of the Grace Hopper track at Fullstack Academy of Code in Chicago. I am a motivated self-starter and thrive in collaborative environments where I am encouraged to think deeply and problem solve creatively and efficiently.

Proficient: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, HTML, CSS, Git
Knowledgeable: React Native, React Bootstrap

company.name: The Grace Hopper Program at Fullstack Academy

positions.title: Assistant Director Of Undergraduate Admission
positions.description:
Experience:
• Managed Northern New Jersey, Central Hudson Valley and Catskills County, NY, Sacramento, CA and San Jose, CA.
• Engaged in research on student demographics including race, socioeconomic background, first generation status, academic and extracurricular opportunity. 
• Identified target schools, planned, and executed recruitment travel. Coordinated 60+ high school visits with counselors and presented information to prospective students and their families at regional events.
• Conducted quantitative and qualitative evaluation of approximately 2000 applications (annually) and identified well-matched candidates for first-year and transfer admission. 
• Utilized data-based resources (College Board Enrollment Planning Services, Western Interstate Commission for Higher Education, Geomarket and Neighborhood reports) and crafted recruitment plans that increased applications by 15% over two cycles.
• Achieved 44% yield for student matriculation consistently.
•Western Association for College Admission Counseling Conference Presenter (June 2017)

positions.title: High School Spanish Teacher
positions.description:
Experience: 
• Taught Spanish I and II courses to high school sophomores, juniors, and seniors.
• Developed and adapted appropriate lesson plans that facilitated learning based on students’ performance. 
• Collected and applied appropriate data to monitor student progress and success. 
• Built relationships with students, parents, administration, and department chair. Communicated course objectives and outcomes.
• Demonstrated classroom management skills.
• Advised a group of 15 freshmen on the college application and financial aid processes.

projects.title: weJay
projects.description:
weJay is an interactive and collaborative mobile playlist application designed to enhance users’ music experiences by sorting songs in real time based upon voting input from users.
• Designed and executed application’s UI and UX design and functionality.
• Implemented stack navigation throughout the application for sleek flow and transitions. 
• Contributed to back end data fetching and technology integration. 
• Tech Stack: React Native, Google Cloud Firestore, Spotify API

projects.title: Bookazon, Inc.
projects.description:
Virtual e-commerce site with full login/signup capabilities, product browsing, and full cart and checkout 
functionality.
• Created and rendered uniform front-end Product and Checkout components throughout the application.
• Integrated Stripe API into front and back ends for convenient payment at checkout.
• Achieved user authentication with Google Oauth.
• Tech Stack: Postgres, React, React Bootstrap, Stripe API
